name: Transglobe Foods Limited
about: Transglobe Foods Limited engages in trading of food grains, fruits, vegetables, and allied products in India. The company trades in fruits, vegetables, various types of fruit jams, tomato ketchup, pastes, purees, and pickles. It is involved in producing, processing, importing, and exporting of vegetarian and non-vegetarian processed foods from grains, cereals, seeds, vegetables, fruits, plants, oilseeds, edible oil, meal, fish, and eggs. Transglobe Foods Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.
